visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with blonde-highlighted hair tied in a bun sits at a light-colored wooden table, holding a document titled 'Prenuptial Agreement' in Traditional Chinese. She gestures with her index finger and smiles while looking directly at the camera in a bright indoor setting with shelves in the background. (2) The scene cuts to a wider shot of her in a modern living room with soft lighting, gesturing energetically while explaining. A man briefly appears behind her. (3) Transitions show the man performing domestic tasks: he throws a white plastic bag into a yellow-rimmed trash can and then loads laundry into a white front-loading washing machine. (4) The woman is seen counting a stack of New Taiwan Dollar bills at a counter. The man's hand enters the frame to give her a single 500-dollar bill. (5) They stand together in a hallway; the woman gestures while talking, and the man playfully touches her shoulder and chin. (6) The man is seen in a different room holding a large, round, orange-striped cat plush toy like an infant. (7) Back at the table, the woman displays five fingers to the camera, then points towards the man. (8) A close-up shows the man's face looking directly into the lens with a slightly wide-eyed expression. (9) The woman holds the legal document again, presenting it to the camera with a confident smile. (10) The final shot shows the man sitting at a desk with a laptop and a large monitor; the woman's hand reaches in to place the prenuptial agreement on his desk.
